# India AI-datacenter account — v1 results (present, operational)

*Generated by `dcfootprint.account.build` on real data. Account year 2024; CEA grid EF 0.6751 tCO2/MWh (incl. RES).*

- **Facilities in account:** 71 (operational, costed, basin-resolved) of 129 operational total — coverage gap = un-costed / un-geocoded.
- **Total carbon:** 4,105,352 tCO2/yr  (inference-attributed ~3,489,549 tCO2/yr at 85%)
- **Total physical water:** 30,145,769 m3/yr  (scope-1 + scope-2)
- **Total scarcity-weighted water:** 1,398,872,844 m3-eq/yr  *(AWARE-weighted; the primary metric)*

### Caveats (v1)

- util/PUE are modeled scalars (R1) -> absolutes are indicative; lead with spatial/relative results.
- scope-2 water scarcity weighted at the facility basin (bounded simplification; true scope-2 = grid-region avg, R3).
- coordinates are ATLAS city-centroids (facilities in one city share a basin); precise geocode pending.
- carbon is national-annual (CEA); India sub-national signal rides on water, by design.
